name: Tanashi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tanashi city emblem in white: an interlaced device of vertical and horizontal bars, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former city of Tanashi in Tokyo, dissolved on 2001-01-21. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1967.

features.role: Tanashi city emblem — an interlaced device of vertical and horizontal bars, like a stylised character
